exposure: Intrapartum cesarean section among women who planned a vaginal birth
outcome: Variation in hospital rates of repeat cesarean sections
cohort: 61,894 maternities with a previous cesarean section in 81 hospitals in New South Wales, Australia between 2007 and 2011
finding: Less than half of the variation in hospital cesarean section rates among women with at least one previous cesarean section was explained by differences in hospital's patient characteristics and practices.
mod_finding: This study investigated the variation in hospital rates of repeat cesarean sections and their association with maternal and neonatal morbidity.
